name: heavy-architect
context_rationale: Requires reading the vault (triage.json, concept.json, risk-register.json, spikes, ADRs, actor files), interactive scope confirmation with the user, and writing multiple human-authored vault files.
summary: Heavy-mode-only skill that produces the comprehensive upfront architecture vault. Writes only the human-authored irreducible files (threat-model.json, cost-estimation.json, requirements.json, non-functional.json, diagrams.json, actors/) rather than derived component/contract/schema files (left to /sync). For brownfield it seeds the component inventory from code-review-graph code-graph analysis.

reads.purpose: Verify mode is Heavy before proceeding; abort if Standard or Minimal
Source of product concept and actor definitions for component decomposition
Confirm all HIGH risks are retired before generating architecture
Existing architectural decisions to respect and link from new vault files
Heavy-mode actor files used as input for component decomposition
Code graph queried for brownfield component seeding (Step 0)

outputs.purpose: STRIDE threat model per component (Step 5) — human-authored
NFRs and compliance constraints — latency, uptime, HIPAA/PCI/SOC2/GDPR mapping (Step 8)
Mermaid system overview and sequence diagrams — human design intent
Heavy-mode actor files with full role-play definitions (Step 2)

tools.name: code-review-graph
tools.invocation: code-review-graph build|update | CRG MCP tools (impact-radius, review-context, search)
tools.purpose: Code graph via code-review-graph (CRG) — builds/refreshes the code graph; reachability / blast-radius / keyword+semantic search via CRG MCP tools. Replaces graphify; vault-graph & multimodal-ingest uses dropped.
tools.note: External pip package (github.com/tirth8205/code-review-graph), MCP-native; graph stored in .code-review-graph/. Replaces graphify.

harness_tools.name: Read
harness_tools.purpose: Read vault prerequisite files and .code-review-graph/ in brownfield step

harness_tools.name: Write
harness_tools.purpose: Write threat-model.json, cost-estimation.json, requirements.json, non-functional.json, diagrams.json, actors/<actor>.md

harness_tools.name: AskUserQuestion
harness_tools.purpose: Step 1 scope confirmation — present planned outline and wait for approval before writing
